title: Page 3
content_zh:
“没忘，啊～～那我上楼了，天云来了要叫我喔。”她很不淑女地打了一个哈欠，不想再继续绕着这个话题打转，马上转身回房。
一听到要去公司上班，她的困意都来了……
第1章(2)
几个小时后，窗外的天色已经一片黑，关佳颖的房里多了一个男人。
杜天云第一次踏进妻子的卧房，环视这间以粉紫色系为主的房间，十足的少女风格，衣柜和梳妆台等家具边上皆有连缀的花朵图样，四处的层柜上还摆放着成排的布偶，和各种日系卡通人物、动物的相关产品。
环顾整个房间，可爱的摆饰不胜枚举，让人有种走进日杂精品屋的错觉。
他走向挂着纱帐的大床，看着床上穿着卡通睡衣、披散着一头乌黑长发的女子，她正抱着桃色小熊舒服地侧躺在柔软的薄被下，白净的脸庞显得年轻而稚气，小巧的五官让她看来比实际年龄还小上一点，更显清纯——
杜天云无声地叹息，真不晓得该高兴还是难过才好。隔了三年不见，他年轻的妻子非但没变老，反倒比记忆中的模样更“嫩”了些，这副水嫩嫩的样子教他很难把她当个女人看，好像对她产生任何“不轨”的想法，都是种邪恶的事一样。
“佳颖。”他轻唤她的名，叫醒沈睡的小女孩。
她紧闭的眼皮动了动，但没睁开。
“佳颖，醒醒。”他以指背轻触她粉嫩的脸庞，加强干扰。
一对长睫毛像粉蝶似地轻颤，却迟迟不肯振翅飞舞。
瞧她睡得如此香甜，他真不忍心叫醒她。
他凝望那脸清纯可人的睡容，一股莫名的怜爱油然而生，手指竟无意识地停留在她吹弹可破的肌肤上，忘了收回……
关佳颖在睡梦中感觉到脸上有股骚动，脑海里便胡里胡涂出现小熊布偶用毛绒绒的熊掌搔她痒，和她在森林里追逐玩闹的画面。
“唔呀不呀……”她吐出一串没人听得懂的声音，伸手抓住“熊掌”，抵抗牠的攻势。
杜天云愣了下，见她抓着自己的大拇指，口齿不清地梦呓着。
“噗……”一阵笑意冲上喉头，让他忍不住失笑，讶异她说梦话的样子怎么会如此可爱，像个小婴儿似的！
听到他的笑声，她慢慢睁开双眼，眼神迷蒙地望着坐在床边的男人。
“……天云。”她认出眼前的男人，扬起唇角。

“我来接妳回家了。”他温柔地说道，俊朗的脸孔上绽放一抹暖阳般的笑容。
“哦，太好了……”她含糊地说，傻傻地笑，又迷迷糊糊地闭上眼。
杜天云来接她回家……她终于要回家了……
这景象她过去三年里已经梦过无数次了，每次在梦境中都会见到她亲爱的老公特地抛下繁忙的工作，不远万里的来找她，让她惊喜万分、欣喜若狂。
太好了，她老公终于来接她回台湾了——
吓！她脑袋一震，赫然想起自己好像已经搭过飞机、回到台湾、见过爸妈、躺到床上——
“天云！”她倏然睁开双眼，惊坐起身，盯着眼前的男人……
不是梦！眼前真的是活生生、很立体、坐在她床边的……她的丈夫！
“你……什么时候来的？”她既惊又喜，神情略带娇羞地望着床边那张她盼望已久的面孔。
虽然一直期盼着见到他的这一刻，不过在毫无心理准备的情况下，突然和他这么面对面地坐在床上四目交接——感觉又好害羞喔……
“刚刚到。”他微笑道，看着她还握住自己的手。
“吓！”她低头一看，连忙松手，紧搂怀里的小熊，奇怪自己怎么会拉着他的手睡觉呢？
真的好害羞喔……
杜天云看着她慌乱之中显得有些手足无措的反应，觉得这女孩实在有趣得很，怎么一副完全没料到他会出现的样子，好像是被他硬生生给吓醒的呢？
“我先到楼下跟爸聊聊，妳慢慢来。”他体贴地留给她独处的空间及充裕的时间，让她缓下情绪，梳洗更衣。
“嗯。”她轻轻点头，在丈夫面前突然就变成一个含蓄的小女人，连正眼盯着他都不太敢。
直到他的身影消失在门边，她还望着门板傻笑了一会儿，然后才像大梦初醒似地跳下床，冲到更衣镜前——
“噢！怎么办，怎么办……我明明说过他来的时候要先叫醒我的，爸妈怎么能让他直接进来呢？”
她抓着凌乱的头发，看着镜中那个披头散发的女人，觉得自己等了三年的这幕重逢画面实在糟透了，和她原先设想的根本完全不一样，她不该是这种乱糟糟的形象！
“不行，我要挽回。”她握拳，下定旁人无法理解的决心，把在老公面前保持最佳形象当成眼前第一要务。

她拿起梳子梳顺一头柔亮的长发，再冲到衣柜前仔细挑选……
三十分钟后，她略施薄粉，扎着编松的公主头、穿着一件粉色洋装，唇角带笑地走下楼，整个人散发出一股名门淑女的高雅气质。
“哇！看看这是谁家的女儿，真像个端庄娴静的淑女呀。”关嘉成一语道破女儿费心经营的好形象，不避讳地在女婿面前拆她的台。
关佳颖轻颦细眉，马上对父亲投去一道抗议的眼神，示意他老人家别在女婿面前乱说话，毁了她在老公心中的形象。
向来她在父母亲面前都展现最真的一面，但在丈夫面前她想要表现最美的一面吶！
“好看吗？”她不理父亲的“破坏”，走至丈夫面前柔声问道。毕竟女为悦己者容，老公的看法才是最重要的。
“很漂亮。”他诚实地给予赞美，觉得此时的她看起来清灵婉约，与刚刚在房内迷糊的模样截然不同，但却同样散发着一股清新甜美的气息。
“谢谢。”听到他的赞美，她的唇边又绽开一朵甜美的笑靥，芳心大悦。
“好了，快把她带回去。”他快看不下去了，女儿在女婿面前就像变了个人似的，简直判若两人。
这真的是他养了二十多年的女儿吗？！
“是呀，你们先回去，改天有空再到家里来坐坐。她的随身行李我已经请人搬到你车上了，其余的我明天再叫人送过去你们家。”谢淑云体谅小两口久别重逢，需要时间独处，就不留他们在家吃晚饭了。其余的几箱行李和家里整理好的部分衣物，也打算等到明天再运到女儿新居，让她慢慢整理。
“好，谢谢妈。那爸、妈，我们就先回去了。”杜天云微微欠身向岳父岳母道别，言行举止总是给人稳重又彬彬有礼的感觉。
“爸妈再见。”关佳颖的道别就简短多了，她满脸笑容地挥别父母，迫不及待要跟丈夫回家的愉快表情，看得老爸爸在背后频摇头。
“妳女儿。”关嘉成遥望着驶离的后车灯，语带感慨地说。
“难道你没份？”谢淑云不以为然地瞥了丈夫一眼，对于老伴都一把年纪了还在跟女婿吃醋这件事，她是看在眼里，笑在心里……
“还不进来吃饭。”
第2章(1)
离开关家位于半山腰的别墅后，杜天云带着关佳颖在住家附近用餐，聊起彼此这几年里分隔两地的生活。
谈话间，大多是她讲、他听。杜天云抛出一个话题，关佳颖就会很认真地回答一大串话，仔细的描述她在欧洲生活了三年的点点滴滴……
“抱歉，我好像太多话了。”她发现餐桌上几乎都是自己的声音，有点不好意思地收了口，可不想在丈夫面前成为一只聒噪的鸭子，比较想当个文静优雅的天鹅公主，因为男人似乎都喜欢那种看起来温柔乖巧，话又不多的气质美女。
content_en:
"I didn't forget, ah~~ Then I'll go upstairs. Tianyun will call me when he comes." She yawned unladylikely, not wanting to continue to dwell on this topic, and immediately turned around and went back to her room.
As soon as she heard that she was going to work in the company, she felt sleepy...
Chapter 1(2)
A few hours later, it was already dark outside the window, and there was a man in Guan Jiaying's room.
Du Tianyun stepped into his wife's bedroom for the first time and looked around at this room, which was mainly pink and purple. It was full of girlish style. There were continuous flower patterns on the edges of furniture such as wardrobes and dressing tables. Rows of dolls and various products related to Japanese cartoon characters and animals were placed on the cabinets everywhere.
Looking around the whole room, there are countless cute decorations, giving people the illusion of walking into a daily necessities boutique.
He walked towards the big bed with gauze curtains and looked at the woman on the bed who was wearing cartoon pajamas and with long black hair. She was holding a peach-colored bear and lying comfortably on her side under the soft thin quilt. Her fair face looked young and childish, and her small facial features made her look a little younger than her actual age and more innocent——
Du Tianyun sighed silently, not knowing whether to be happy or sad. After not seeing each other for three years, his young wife not only did not age, but actually looked more "young" than in his memory. This tender look made it difficult for him to regard her as a woman, as if having any "unfair" thoughts about her was an evil thing.
"Jiaying." He whispered her name to wake up the sleeping little girl.
Her closed eyelids moved but did not open.
"Jiaying, wake up." He lightly touched her pink face with the back of his fingers to intensify the interference.
A pair of long eyelashes fluttered like butterflies, but they refused to flutter.
Seeing how sweetly she slept, he couldn't bear to wake her up.
He stared at the innocent and lovely sleeping face, and an inexplicable affection arose spontaneously. His fingers unconsciously stayed on her skin that could be broken by blowing, and he forgot to take it back...
In her sleep, Guan Jiaying felt a commotion on her face, and images of a stuffed bear tickling her with its fluffy paws and chasing her in the forest appeared in her mind.
"Uh, no, no..." She uttered a string of sounds that no one could understand, and reached out to grab the "bear's paw" to resist its offensive.
Du Tianyun was stunned for a moment and saw her grabbing his thumb and mumbling incoherently.
"Pfft..." A burst of laughter rushed up his throat, and he couldn't help laughing. He was surprised that she looked so cute when talking in her sleep, like a little baby!
Hearing his laughter, she slowly opened her eyes and looked at the man sitting beside the bed with hazy eyes.
"...Tianyun." She recognized the man in front of her and raised the corners of her lips.
"I'm here to take you home." He said softly, with a warm smile on his handsome face.
"Oh, great..." she said vaguely, smiled silly, and closed her eyes in a daze.
Du Tianyun came to take her home... She was finally going home...
She has dreamed about this scene countless times in the past three years. Every time in her dream, she would see her dear husband leaving his busy work and traveling thousands of miles to come to her, which made her extremely surprised and ecstatic.
Great, her husband finally came to take her back to Taiwan——
Scared! Her head jolted, and she suddenly remembered that she had already taken a plane, returned to Taiwan, met her parents, and lay on the bed——
"Tianyun!" She suddenly opened her eyes, sat up in shock, and stared at the man in front of her...
Not a dream! In front of her eyes was a real, three-dimensional person sitting beside her bed...her husband!
"When... did you come?" She was surprised and happy, looking at the face she had been looking forward to for so long beside the bed with a slightly shy expression.
Although I have been looking forward to this moment of seeing him, but without any psychological preparation, I suddenly sat face to face with him on the bed and made eye contact - I felt so shy...
"JustJust arrived. "He smiled, looking at her still holding his hand.
"Scared! "She looked down, quickly let go, and hugged the little bear tightly in her arms. She wondered why she was holding his hand to sleep?
So shy...
Du Tianyun looked at her panicked reaction and felt that this girl was really interesting. Why did she look like she didn't expect him to appear at all, as if she was frightened awake by him?
"I'll go downstairs to talk to Dad first, you take your time. "He thoughtfully left her alone space and plenty of time to relax, freshen up and change clothes.
"Hmm. "She nodded lightly and suddenly turned into a reserved little woman in front of her husband, not even daring to look him in the eyes.
Until his figure disappeared by the door, she still looked at the door panel and giggled for a while, then jumped out of bed as if she had just woken up from a dream, and rushed to the dressing mirror——
"Oh! What should I do, what should I do... I clearly said that he would wake me up first when he came. How could my parents let him come in directly? "
She grabbed her messy hair and looked at the disheveled woman in the mirror. She felt that the reunion scene she had been waiting for for three years was really terrible. It was completely different from what she had originally imagined. She shouldn't have such a messy image!
"No, I want to save it. "She clenched her fists and made a determination that others could not understand. She made maintaining the best image in front of her husband her top priority.
She picked up a comb and combed her long, soft hair, then rushed to the wardrobe to select carefully...
Thirty minutes later, she lightly powdered her hair, wore a pink dress, and a pink dress. She walked downstairs with a smile on her lips. She exuded the elegance of a well-known lady.
"Wow! Look whose daughter this is, she looks like a dignified and quiet lady. "Guan Jiacheng revealed in one sentence the good image that his daughter had worked so hard to cultivate, and he did not shy away from tearing her down in front of his son-in-law.
Guan Jiaying raised her eyebrows lightly and immediately cast a protesting look at her father, signaling him not to talk nonsense in front of her son-in-law and ruin her image in her husband's heart.
She has always shown her truest side in front of her parents, but she wants to show her most beautiful side in front of her husband!
"Does it look good? "Ignoring her father's "sabotage", she walked up to her husband and asked softly. After all, a woman wants to please her own appearance, and her husband's opinion is the most important.
"It's beautiful. " He gave the compliment honestly, feeling that she looked clear and graceful at this time, which was completely different from the confused look in the room just now, but she still exuded a fresh and sweet atmosphere.
"Thank you. "Hearing his praise, another sweet smile bloomed on her lips, and her heart was filled with joy.
"Okay, take her back quickly. "He could hardly stand it anymore. His daughter seemed to be a different person in front of his son-in-law. She was completely different from the other two.
Is this really the daughter he has raised for more than 20 years? !
"Yes, you go back first, and come and sit at home some other time when you have time. I've already asked someone to move her carry-on luggage to your car, and I'll ask someone to deliver the rest to your house tomorrow. "Xie Shuyun understood that the young couple needed time to be alone after a long absence, so she would not leave them at home to have dinner. The remaining boxes of luggage and some of the clothes that had been packed at home were also planned to be shipped to her daughter's new residence tomorrow so that she could sort them out slowly.
"Okay, thank you mom. Then Dad, Mom, let’s go back first. "Du Tianyun bowed slightly to say goodbye to his father-in-law and mother-in-law. His words and deeds always gave people a sense of stability and courtesy.
"Goodbye, parents. "Guan Jiaying's farewell was much briefer. She said goodbye to her parents with a smile on her face, and she couldn't wait to go home with her husband. Her happy expression made her father shake his head frequently behind her.
"Your daughter. "Guan Jiacheng looked at the rear lights of the car driving away and said with emotion.
"Don't you have a share? "Xie Shuyun glanced at her husband disapprovingly. She said that her husband was still jealous of his son-in-law even at his age.See it in your eyes, smile in your heart...
"You haven't come in to eat yet."
Chapter 2(1)
After leaving the Guan family's villa halfway up the mountain, Du Tianyun took Guan Jiaying to dine near their home and chatted about their lives apart in the past few years.
During the conversation, she mostly talked and he listened. When Du Tianyun brings up a topic, Guan Jiaying will answer a series of questions very seriously, carefully describing every detail of her three years in Europe...
"Sorry, I seem to talk too much." She found that her own voice was almost everywhere at the dinner table, and she stopped a little embarrassed. She didn't want to be a noisy duck in front of her husband. She preferred to be a quiet and elegant swan princess, because men seemed to like the kind of temperamental beauties who looked gentle and well-behaved and didn't talk much.
